description.LOCATOR_REGEN_LIBCST: Generate ID-based locator (#id) and patch script preserving format using LibCST. Highest confidence strategy.
description.FALLBACK_LOCATOR: Generate attribute-based locator (aria-label, placeholder, name, type) when no ID available.
description.FALLBACK_XPATH: Generate XPath locator when element has no CSS-friendly attributes. Lower confidence.
description.CLICK_ONLY: Specialized healing for button/link click actions. Optimized for clickable elements.
description.WAIT_RETRY: Add wait/retry logic when element appears late or is temporarily unavailable.
description.TEMPLATE_REPAIR: Apply a repair template for common RPA patterns and known failure scenarios.
description.NO_FIX: Insufficient data, empty DOM, or unsafe patch conditions. No healing performed.
